mapper.select: select a.id, a.password, a.username, a.dept_id, a.nickname, a.avatar, a.email, a.mobile, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.code as role_code, e.code as permission_code from sys_user a left join sys_user_role b on a.id = b.user_id and b.is_delete = 0 left join sys_role c on b.role_id = c.id and c.is_enabled = 1 and c.is_delete = 0 left join sys_role_permission d on c.id = d.role_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join sys_permission e on d.permission_id = e.id and e.is_enabled = 1 and e.is_delete = 0 where a.username = #{username}

select a.id, a.username, a.nickname, a.avatar, a.email, a.mobile, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.code as roleCode from sys_user a left join sys_user_role b on a.id = b.user_id left join sys_role c on b.role_id = c.id where 1 = 1
and a.username like concat('%', #{query.username}, '%')
limit 1

select a.id, a.username, a.nickname, a.avatar, a.email, a.mobile, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.code as roleCode from sys_user a left join sys_user_role b on a.id = b.user_id left join sys_role c on b.role_id = c.id where 1 = 1
and a.username like concat('%', #{query.username}, '%')
order by a.create_time desc
